correctness.rationale: The annihilator Rz is characterized functorially, so every automorphism over a commutative R has the block form with A^T A=cI; converse is immediate. Its dual-number linearization yields tangent dimension n+n(n+1)/2 in characteristic 2 and n+n(n−1)/2+1 otherwise. In char2, b(v,v)=b(w,v)^2 forces all geometric isometries to fix w; odd n gives Sp_(n−1), even n gives explicit (n−1)-parameter symplectic extensions, each with dimension n(n−1)/2. After accounting for the similitude multiplier and free shears the geometric dimension is n+1+n(n−1)/2, producing the exact n−1 excess. A diagonal mu_2^(n−1) exhibits nonreduced directions. Symplectic-frame counting gives the finite-field orders. Seven complete finite-field Gram-matrix checks and 44 linearized matrix-rank checks run successfully in the actual included verifier; finite cases corroborate but do not prove the general theorem. No unproved generality is asserted.
